d:
30 minat yog myujik - kya aap apne yog abhyas ke lie shant vatavran banana chahte hain? yah 30 minat ka yog sangit aapke man ko ekagr karne men madad karega.
Is vidiyo men aapko sukhad aur shant dhunen sunne ko milengi, jo dhyan ke lie sangit ke rup men vishesh rup se taiyar ki gaee hain. yah sangit satr aapke dainik yog abhyas ko adhik gahra aur aaramdayak banane ke lie ekdam sahi hai.
Chahe aap gahri streching kar rahe hon ya pranayam, yah shantipurn sangit aapko ek shant sthiti men le jane men madad karega. ise chalaen aur apne yog satr ka pura labh uthaen.
